verdict.rationale: Docusign has no llms.txt (confirmed 404 probe) but does provide agent-oriented documentation such as the Claude MCP connector guide, an official MCP server, and machine-readable OpenAPI specs explicitly described as enabling 'computers to discover and understand the capabilities of the service.' This covers part of the story but lacks the specific llms.txt convention many AI-native tools expect. missing for 10: llms.txt file, dedicated agent-facing doc index, independent confirmation that agents can consume these docs successfully.
